provenance: Source is vendored, not fetched: the build does not need the upstream repository to still exist. 'commit' records where the tree came from and is the only record of it -- a binary built from the vendored source reports 'mod (devel)', because building outside a git checkout yields no pseudo-version. The binary committed at network/guest/bin/vaptr predates vendoring and still reports v0.0.0-20260729160916-ddef5e9a6a66, which is that same commit.
verification: Not by sha256: Go stamps a build ID from the build action graph, so identical source produces different bytes on different hosts. Check size (6684834) and toolchain instead: 'go version -m network/guest/bin/vaptr'.
